description: Libra decan 2 (October 3 to October 12): personality, love, work and growth, with Uranus as sub-ruler of the second ten degrees of Libra.
answer: In Western astrology, the second decan of Libra covers 10° to 19° of the sign, roughly October 3 to October 12, with Uranus as its sub-ruler beside Venus. It is read as fairness turned outward into ideals, networks and fresh social thinking. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Libra decan 2 personality
paragraphs: Between 10 and 19 degrees, Libra picks up Uranus as its sub-ruler, the modern planet associated with Aquarius. Uranus is the zodiac's disruptor, and pairing it with a sign devoted to balance produces an interesting tension. Instead of asking whether a single relationship is fair, this decan tends to ask whether the whole system is. Natives are often described as socially progressive, curious about how communities organise themselves and impatient with conventions that exist only because nobody questioned them. Their charm is still unmistakably Libran, but it comes with an independent streak and a taste for ideas that have not yet become mainstream.

The Uranian influence can make this decan feel cooler and more cerebral than the first. People here frequently relate through shared principles rather than shared routines, and they may have wide circles of friends drawn from very different walks of life. Freedom matters to them, sometimes in surprising ways for a sign so associated with partnership. Traditional astrologers linked this stretch with justice in a collective sense, and that echo still seems apt: many natives are energised by a cause. The trade-off is a tendency to intellectualise feelings, stepping back into theory just when a moment calls for warmth or a simple, personal response.

sections.heading: Libra decan 2 in love and at work
paragraphs: Romantically, Uranus's decan of Libra tends to want a partner who is also a friend, an equal and an interesting mind. Conventional scripts about how relationships should look may hold little appeal; they would rather design an arrangement that actually fits two real people. Space is important, and so is the freedom to keep separate interests. Because fairness ranks so high for them, roles are often negotiated openly rather than assumed. The risk is emotional distance when things get messy. Choosing to stay present in an awkward feeling, rather than analysing it from across the room, usually deepens the bond considerably.

Professionally, this decan is often drawn to work with a social dimension: policy, advocacy, community building, technology that connects people, user research or any field where systems need redesigning with people in mind. They tend to be good at spotting where a process is quietly unfair and proposing something smarter. Networking comes easily because they enjoy variety and collect contacts across disciplines. Rigid hierarchies can frustrate them. They usually perform best with autonomy and a clear sense of purpose, and they may need colleagues who handle the slower, detailed follow-through once the big idea has been agreed.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Libra decan 2: what Uranus adds
paragraphs: The second decan covers 10° to 19° of Libra, which in most years means birthdays from October 3 to October 12. Its sub-ruler, Uranus, comes from Aquarius, the next air sign after Libra, so this decan borrows a little of Aquarius's character while staying Libra at heart. The other two decans of Libra belong to Venus (decan 1) and Mercury (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Uranus brings originality, independence and a taste for the unconventional. Its decans tend to be described as more inventive and contrarian, quick to question tradition, attached to freedom and comfortable standing slightly apart from the crowd. Uranian decans are often linked with technology, reform, science and unusual lifestyles, and their usual lesson is to stay connected while staying free. Set against Libra's fairness, charm, diplomacy and an eye for proportion, that Uranus note shifts the emphasis without changing the sign underneath.

sections.heading: Growth for Libra decan 2
paragraphs: A growth edge for middle-decan Libra is bringing ideals down to the scale of everyday relationships. It can be easier to care about fairness in the abstract than to sit with one person's disappointment. One practical step is pairing every cause with a concrete, local action, so principles have somewhere to land. Another is checking whether detachment is clarity or avoidance; a short pause to ask what they personally feel can help. They need not give up independence. The aim is to let warmth travel alongside the vision, so people feel included by their ideas rather than lectured by them.

Within Libra, decan 1 leans towards harmony, taste and partnership in their most concentrated form and decan 3 leans towards diplomacy expressed through words, debate and nimble negotiation. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: Why is the second decan of Libra linked with Uranus?
faq.answer: In the triplicity system, the middle decan of a sign borrows the ruler of the next sign in the same element. After Libra, the next air sign is Aquarius, whose modern ruler is Uranus, so this decan gains an inventive, independent and socially minded flavour.

faq.question: What are the dates of Libra decan 2?
faq.answer: In most years October 3 to October 12, the days when the Sun is between 10° and 19° of Libra. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Libra decan 2?
faq.answer: Uranus. In the triplicity system each air sign's decans take the rulers of the air signs in order, starting with Libra's own ruler, Venus.
